html:
Diamond Value Widget

You can add a diamond calculator to your website with CaratBase's diamond value widget. The widget is available in a free version and a paid version, Widget Pro, which costs $12/month per domain.

How it Works

The diamond value widget is easy to add to your website. You can choose between a free version with a 'Powered by CaratBase' line or Widget Pro. With Widget Pro, you get a custom call to action and inquiries go directly to you.

Features

CaratBase offers free diamond, gold, and jewelry calculators. The site has 250+ reference pages, 37 ring sizes in 5 systems, and 21 gem types. You can use these tools to help your customers value diamonds and other jewelry.

FAQ

What is the difference between the free and paid widgets? The free widget includes a 'Powered by CaratBase' line, while the paid version, Widget Pro, offers a custom call to action and direct inquiries. Can I use the widget on multiple websites? No, the Widget Pro subscription is $12/month per domain. Is the widget easy to add to my website? Yes, the widget is easy to add to your website, and you can find more information on the widgets page.

Next, learn more about the diamond value widget and how to add it to your website on the widgets page.
